{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to completed orders
completed = data[data['status'] == 'completed']
completed_count = len(completed)
print(f"Number of completed orders: {completed_count}")

# Check revenue format: it's string with commas
print("Sample of revenue values after filtering:")
print(completed['revenue'].head(10))

# Convert revenue to float: remove commas and cast
completed['revenue_numeric'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = completed['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed set: {qa_count}")

# Drop QA orders
completed_clean = completed[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_clean['revenue_numeric'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
